limitations: A/B/C are neutral native-agent groups, not host brands or model rankings.
Canonical receipts establish a local MCP loop, not independent author identity or general gameplay correctness.
Controller observations and file hashes bind local evidence, not cryptographic identity or semantic truth.
Complete controller coverage yields READY_FOR_CONTROLLER_ACCEPTANCE; the controller must review semantics before any simulated project acceptance claim.
This profile never changes the original real-host 15-cell matrix or formal acceptance counts.
Native authoring boundaries in this profile are instruction-only; OS isolation remains unverified.

coverageRequirements.replay: For both air and three, record a second distinct runtime Session, same seed, complete input trace, tick and exactHash comparison. Restarting the first Session is not independent replay.
coverageRequirements.inputCoverage: Record actual canvas input on both backends. Optional input checks may be NOT_APPLICABLE only with NOT_DECLARED applicability, a specific reason and SHA-bound evidence of the absent candidate contract. Unsupported declared or task-required inputs remain FAIL/PARTIAL. Blur and restart input clearing are mandatory. G17 requires hold or drag; declared drag requires cancellation coverage.
coverageRequirements.runtimeObservations: For both air and three, retain console/page-error logs and measured performance samples with metric, units, sample interval, environment and limitations; do not infer performance from absence of errors.
coverageRequirements.scope: Structural local-controller coverage only: no automated semantics, human quality, real client, OS isolation, physical input or GPU-internal cache attestation.
